purpose: bounded paired GT-supervised STE-FlowNet network-fit and independent-layout diagnostic; not a formal long-run comparison

model.name: STE-FlowNet
model.input: official STE five equal-event-count Gaussian-count temporal bins per polarity, 320x240 native raster; symmetric zero-pad to 352x352

data.physical_sample: one full (0,30ms] event window and matched 30ms endpoint flow per registered scene/path rollout
data.split: complete layout family: sc0/sc1 train; sc2 validation

pairing.sample_replacement: repeat a seeded permutation of the four train rollouts until the fixed update budget is met

objective.type: four-scale robust endpoint error from the existing Stage 5 synthetic GT pilot

diagnostic_budget.success_interpretation: evidence that the real STE-FlowNet optimization path can fit these camera-motion samples; not evidence of independent generalization or generator superiority

evaluation_masks.primary_diagnostic: fixed paired union of nonzero normal-input EventGenesis and V2E event pixels intersected with shared visibility-checked GT validity
evaluation_masks.empty_active_mask: preserve and report null active EPE; do not filter the rollout

limits: four train and two held-out layout-family rollouts; one sample per trajectory
camera-only static-scene motion; moving objects and dynamic occlusion are not covered
this diagnostic does not replace the formal synthetic training protocol or any real test
